protocol: Fresh fixed-budget server per candidate. Sequential Metal runs. 15 input / 8 output warmup, then two uncached 4000 input / 64 output HTTP requests, greedy decoding, seed 42, EOS ignored. TTFT starts at request dispatch, ends at the first token. Decode rate is 63 divided by the first-to-last-token interval. Total ends at completion of the stream. Startup excluded, OS file cache uncontrolled. Limits apply to the engine ledger. Native wide prefill was automatic. No live resize.
selection: Require verified wide prefill of all 4000 tokens with four workers in both runs. Rank by mean end-to-end time. Prefer no draft when its mean total is within five percent of the fastest qualifying candidate and its mean decode rate is at least ninety percent of that candidate. The fastest-decode alternative is ranked by mean decode TPS across all completed candidates. Results describe the measured prompt and two requests per candidate.
